senses.gloss:
शोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, brilliant, handsome;
(आ), f. light, lustre, radiance, splendor, sheen, bril-
liancy; beauty, elegance, grace, comeliness; dis-
tinguished merit; turmeric; the yellow pigment
गो-रोचना; a species of the Kṛti metre.
—शोभ-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing lustre, beautifying; (त्), m. the
thirty-seventh (or sixth) year of Jupiter's cycle of
sixty years [cf. शुभ-कृत्]; the marking-nut
plant.
—शोभा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing lustre,
beautifying.
—शोभाञ्जन (˚भा-अञ्˚), अस्, m. the
tree Hyperanthera Moringa (commonly called Śa-
jinā; it is much valued for its various properties;
the legumes, blossoms, and leaves are esculent;
the root of the young tree is used as a substitute for
horse-radish as well as a stimulant in medicine, and
the expressed oil of the seeds is said to relieve
arthritic pains; it has a great many synonyms; cf.
शिग्रु, नील-शिग्रु, काक्षीवक, जन-प्रिय, च-
क्षुष्य, &c.).
—शोभा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, full of
lustre or beauty; beautiful.
—शोभा-वती, f., N. of
a town.

शोभ शोभ, शोभन, शोभित, &c. See
under rt. 1. शुभ्.

सोभ सोभ, अम्, n., Ved., N. of the city of
the Gandharvas; [cf. सम्भ.]

शोभथ, Ved. splendor, (used only in the inst.
c. शोभथा.)

शोभन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, adorning, causing to
look beautiful, shining, splendid; beautiful, hand-
some, (sometimes used ironically); richly dressed or
ornamented; propitious, auspicious; virtuous, de-
corous, good, moral; (अस्), m. a burnt offering for
auspicious results; epithet of Śiva; epithet of the
eleventh year of Jupiter's cycle; a planet; the fifth
of the astronomical Yogas; (आ), f. turmeric; the
yellow pigment गो-रोचना; (अम्), n. the act of
adorning or causing to look beautiful; the being
bright or handsome, brilliance, sheen; a lotus.
—शोभन-वाह, अस्, आ, अम्, having splendid car-
riers or horses.
—शोभनाचरित (˚न-आच्˚), अम्, n.
virtuous practice.

शोभनक, अस्, m. the tree Hyperanthera Mo-
ringa (= शोभाञ्जन above).
शोभनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be beautified or adorned.

शोभमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, looking beauti-
ful or handsome, splendid, fair.

शोभयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, orna-
menting, decorating.

शोभस्, अस्, n., Ved. splendor, beauty, (the dat.
c. शोभसे is used as a Ved. Inf.; Sāy. = शोभनार्-
थम्.)

शोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, beautiful, adorned, decorated,
trimmed, made splendid.

शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shining, brilliant, beautiful,
handsome, distinguished, exceeding.

शोभिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most brilliant, very
handsome or beautiful.

सोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in or belonging
to Sobha.

सोभरि सोभरि, इस्, m., N. of the author
of the hymns Ṛg-veda VIII. 19 — 22, &c. (having the
patronymic Kāṇva).

सोभाञ्जन सोभाञ्जन, अस्, m. (= शोभाञ्-
जन), the tree Hyperanthera Moringa.
